Le divayisi ayisenawo ukhiye wedatha ebethelwe ye-app, ngakho i-app iqale ingenalutho. Akukho okususiwe. Ukuze ubuyise uhlu lwakho lokubuka ne-portfolio, ngenisa ifayela lesipele ngaphansi kokuthi “%1$s” ku-Izilungiselelo.
Idatha elondoloziwe ayikwazanga ukuvulwa
Imemori ekhululekile ayanele ukuvikela noma ukuvula isipele ngephasiwedi. Vala amanye ama-app bese uzama futhi.
Buyisela isipele
Ngiyezwa
Idatha elondoloziwe ivulwe futhi
Ukhiye wangaphambilini kule divayisi uvule futhi idatha ebibekwe eceleni, ngakho isibuyile. Idatha elondolozwe phakathi nalokho igcinwe ingashintshiwe eduze kwayo.
Izilungiselelo zisethwe kabusha
Izilungiselelo zakho azikwazanga ukufundwa futhi zibuyiselwe kokuzenzakalelayo. Sicela uhlole ukhiye we-portfolio, isikhathi sama-alamu nohlobo lwemali.
Ukubuyisela kuphazamisekile
I-app ivaliwe ngesikhathi ibuyisela isipele. Idatha yakho yangaphambilini ibuyiselwe; akukho okugcinwe kusipele.

I-app ivaliwe ngesikhathi ibuyisela isipele, futhi idatha yangaphambilini ayikwazanga ukubuyiselwa ngokuphelele. Sicela uhlole uhlu lwakho lokubuka ne-portfolio, noma ubuyisele isipele futhi ngaphansi kokuthi “%1$s” ku-Izilungiselelo.
Ifayela lesipele alikwazanga ukuqinisekiswa ngemuva kokulondoloza – lifundeka ngokwehlukile. Sicela ulondoloze isipele efayeleni elisha.
I-portfolio ayibuyiselwanga esipeleni sesistimu
Ikhophi ye-portfolio esipeleni sesistimu ye-Android ayikwazanga ukufundwa, ngisho nasemzamweni wesibili, futhi isusiwe. Uma unefayela lesipele, libuyisele ngaphansi kokuthi “%1$s” ku-Izilungiselelo.
